# GitHub Linguist PR: Add Sounio (.sio)

## Prepared PR for github-linguist/linguist

### Entry for languages.yml

```yaml
Sounio:
  type: programming
  color: "#4B8BBE"
  extensions:
    - ".sio"
  tm_scope: source.sounio
  ace_mode: rust
  codemirror_mode: rust
  codemirror_mime_type: text/x-rustsrc
  # language_id: (auto-generated by script/update-ids)
```

### Grammar source

TextMate grammar hosted at: https://github.com/Sounio-lang/sounio/blob/main/.github/linguist/sounio.tmLanguage.json

### Sample files

From https://github.com/Sounio-lang/sounio:
- `examples/hello.sio` — Hello world
- `examples/fibonacci.sio` — Basic recursion
- `benchmarks/humaneval_sounio/001_two_sum.sio` — Algorithm benchmark
- `stdlib/encoding/hex.sio` — Standard library module
- `stdlib/functional/calculus.sio` — Numerical computing
